test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pester
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annoy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SYNONYM **is a phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word.
 
• The word **Pester **means irritate or annoy (someone) by making repeated or persistent requests or interruptions (व्‍यक्ति को परेशान कर देना)
 
• The word **Annoy **means to disturb or irritate especially by repeated acts. (ग़ुस्‍सा दिलाना)
 
• The meaning of word pester is similar to the meaning of word annoy, **hence option 3 is correct annoy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Abuse **means cruelty or violence, especially on a regular or repeated basis

*Example *: "I told my brother he would have to stop abusing in front of kids."

 
• The word **Adore **means deeply admire , love and respect (someone). (स्‍नेह और आदर की भावना)

*Example *: Every mother **adores **their children.

 
• The word **Amuse **means cause (someone) to discover something funny. (किसी बात का मज़ेदार लगना)

*Example *: I am really **amused **by the way she behaved.
